decks.notes: The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures while utilizing blink effects to generate value and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining cards like Quantum Riddler, Flickerwisp, and Ephemerate with powerful creatures like Emperor of Bones and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, the deck can maintain board presence and control. Thoughtseize and Teferi, Time Raveler provide disruption and card advantage, while cards like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending help to deal with opposing threats. The deck's strategy is to apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, and removal spells. It aims to control the game by efficiently removing threats and countering key spells, while also utilizing card advantage and card selection to outvalue the opponent. The deck includes a mix of efficient removal in Fatal Push and board wipes like Sheoldred's Edict, as well as powerful threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Wan Shi Tong, Librarian. It aims to disrupt and control the game until it can win with its powerful creatures and spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to generate mana and card advantage while aggressively pushing towards victory. By playing cards like Urza's Saga and Mox Opal, the deck can quickly ramp up its resources and deploy threats such as Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Cori-Steel Cutter. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Metallic Rebuke and Unholy Heat allows the deck to control the board and protect its key pieces. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly building a board presence and overwhelming the opponent with efficient plays and card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control elements, such as counterspells, removal, and card advantage, to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly setting up win conditions. By combining disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push with powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Quantum Riddler, the deck aims to control the game and overpower the opponent with card advantage and efficient threats. Additionally, the inclusion of card draw spells like Subtlety and Consign to Memory helps ensure the deck has the resources necessary to outlast the opponent and secure victory.

This aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost creatures and controlling the board with disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Stubborn Denial. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support for the aggressive strategy by boosting creature power. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Scion of Draco, and Territorial Kavu are key threats that can quickly close out games if left unchecked. Quantum Riddler and Psychic Frog offer card advantage and disruption, while Wrath of the Skies can clear the board if needed. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and disruption.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. It utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Galvanic Discharge to put pressure on the opponent early on. The deck also includes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Guide of Souls for card advantage and board presence. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah is included for additional threats and removal. Overall, this deck aims to win the game quickly by constantly attacking and pressuring the opponent, while also having some removal options to handle threats.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures, using control spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to stall the game with cards like Orim's Chant and Malevolent Rumble, while setting up for big plays with Emrakul, the Promised End and Sire of Seven Deaths. By utilizing Eldrazi Temple and other mana ramp cards, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats and control the board until victory is achieved.

The deck focuses on using mill cards to destroy the opponent's library quickly, with key cards like Ruin Crab, Hedron Crab, and Archive Trap. It also includes disruption and removal spells like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to control the game. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with mill effects and prevent them from drawing important cards, ultimately leading to victory by depleting their library. The deck's strategy revolves around efficiently milling the opponent while disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on cheating powerful creatures onto the battlefield by discarding them and then reanimating them. It uses cards like Persist and Ephemerate to bring them back from the graveyard, while also utilizing cards like Faithful Mending and Solitude for card advantage and protection. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation while setting up its combo pieces. The key strategy involves reanimating creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones to overwhelm the opponent and win the game.

This deck focuses on generating mana with Springleaf Drum and Eldrazi Temple to power out big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command. It also utilizes cards like Malevolent Rumble and Blade of the Bloodchief to control the board and build up powerful creatures. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection for the combo pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and spells while disrupting their game plan with removal and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of cards to quickly power up Cosmogoyf and overwhelm the opponent with massive damage. By exploiting cards like Devourer of Destiny, Spoils of the Vault, and Plunge into Darkness, the deck aims to set up explosive plays that take advantage of the graveyard and manipulate life totals. With an emphasis on speed and aggression, the deck looks to quickly assemble its combo pieces to create an unstoppable force that can end the game in a flash.

The deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board presence by utilizing artifacts and synergies among them. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures, powerful artifacts like Engineered Explosives and Urza's Saga, and disruptive spells like Metallic Rebuke. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps in recurring key artifacts while Mishra's Bauble and Pithing Needle provide additional utility. The deck is designed to maintain pressure and control the game with a mix of threats and answers, ultimately aiming to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by combining creature blinking with removal and disruption. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to repeatedly exile and return creatures for various effects, the deck aims to outpace opponents and control the board. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push offer disruption, while creatures like Solitude and Overlord of the Balemurk provide additional removal options. Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Witch Enchanter offer additional value by triggering off blink effects. The deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and strategic disruption.

The deck focuses on using creatures to generate mana and search for specific creatures using Green Sun's Zenith. It aims to create a board presence with a variety of creatures that can generate mana or provide utility, eventually leading to a powerful finisher like Craterhoof Behemoth. The Leyline of Abundance helps ramp up mana production, while Agatha's Soul Cauldron provides additional value by sacrificing creatures. Overall, the deck utilizes a toolbox of creatures to control the board and create a strong combo finish.

This deck focuses on aggressive, quick plays with a mix of red, green, white, blue, and black cards. It utilizes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco, along with efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Leyline Binding. The deck also includes counterspells like Stubborn Denial to protect its threats. By playing a mix of colors, it can take advantage of a variety of powerful spells and creatures to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently. The strategy is to maintain early pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main idea behind this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by denying them resources while generating card advantage through cards like Snapcaster Mage and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The win condition is achieved by gradually wearing down the opponent's resources until they can no longer respond to the threats presented by the deck's threats like Wan Shi Tong, Librarian and Subtlety.
